articles.dek: The Netherlands and France have moved their gold out of US vaults. Part of the reason is fears about the reliability of the US, but equally important is the need to keep gold closer to home in the event of a crisis.

articles.title: Ingebrigtsen pulls out of 1,500, leaving Kerr, Hocker and the field to race for $150K
articles.dek: Jakob Ingebrigtsen says he's withdrawing from the 1,500-meter race at track's Ultimate Championship, depriving the sport of one of its marquee showdowns after the Norwegian's most recent round of disagreements with top rivals Cole Hocker and Josh Kerr.
